main.description: Search performers: active published projects, and DJs whose profile has the performer section on and that staff list. A DJ's profile counts as a solo act, and a solo project managed only by a listed DJ is left out for their profile. Sorts by relevance with q, by distance with a location, and newest first otherwise (a profile by when it was listed).

q.description: Words to find in names, taglines, bios, genres, and places. Each word matches as a prefix, and every word must match.

latE6.description: Latitude in millionths of a degree, like a location's latE6.

lngE6.description: Longitude in millionths of a degree.

genres.description: Matches performers playing any of these genres or a close subgenre.

kinds.description: Matches projects of these kinds, and DJs' profiles when solo is one.

formats.description: Matches performers with any of these formats.

setTypes.description: Matches performers doing any of these set types.

unclaimed.description: Only projects nobody manages yet, and so no DJs' profiles.
